name: Windows - Event Errors
description: The Windows - Event Errors dashboards provide insights into error keyword trends and outliers.
title: Windows - Event Errors

panels.title: Error Keyword by Computer and Message

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   "\"Level\":\"Error\""
| json "EventID", "Computer", "Level", "Message" as event_id, host, level, msg_summary nodrop
| where level = "Error" and host matches "{{host}}"
| if (msg_summary matches "*error*", "error_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Error*", "error_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*exception*", "exception_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Exception*", "exception_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*fail*", "fail_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Fail*", "fail_keyword", "no_error_keywords")))))))) as keyword_tag
| count by keyword_tag, host, msg_summary
| sort by _count, keyword_tag, host, msg_summary

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   "\"Level\":\"Error\""
| json "EventID", "Computer", "Level", "Message" as event_id, host, level, msg_summary nodrop
| where level = "Error" and host matches "{{host}}"
| if (msg_summary matches "*error*", "error_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Error*", "error_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*exception*", "exception_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Exception*", "exception_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Timeout*", "timeout_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*fail*", "fail_keyword", if (msg_summary matches "*Fail*", "fail_keyword", "no_error_keywords")))))))) as keyword_tag
| timeslice 15m
| count by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(15m)
| outlier _count

panels.title: Keyword Tags
panels.text: If a Windows event message contains "error", "timeout", "exception" or "fail" Sumo Logic tags the message with "error_keyword", "timeout_keyword", "exception_keyword" or "fail_keyword" respectively.
